summary.text: Dave Stuebe, listed by Ballotpedia as David Stuebe, is a Republican member of the Washington House of Representatives for District 17-Position 2, in office since January 13, 2025, and he is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Diana Perez.
A retired Marine Corps colonel, he is also the mayor of Washougal.

paragraphs.text: Stuebe served in the U.S. Marine Corps, on active duty and in the reserves, for 30 years and retired as a colonel, according to his House Republican biography.
Ballotpedia lists his service as 1986 to 2016, says he graduated from Fallbrook High School and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Redlands in 1983.
He also worked for more than 20 years in management and leadership roles in the pharmaceutical and health care industries.
Stuebe was appointed to the Washougal City Council in March 2021 and was elected to the council and named mayor pro tem that November.
The council appointed him mayor in September 2022, and he won the office in 2025.
He succeeded Republican Paul Harris in the House.
His biography lists his priorities as public safety, affordable housing and stronger communities in Southwest Washington.
